title: Add order totals to the Checkout v2 response
author: mina
head: checkout-v2
body: The new checkout endpoint reads orders.total_amount and returns the KRW total. Existing clients receive the same response.

title: Standardize monetary columns as amount_cents
author: dan
head: money-in-cents
body: Standardize all monetary values as integer cents. The migration runs before deployment.

files.patch:
@@ -18,5 +18,5 @@
-SELECT id, total_amount FROM orders
+SELECT id, amount_cents FROM orders

title: Reduce the payment.captured event payload
author: jiho
head: payment-event-v3
body: Remove redundant fields from payment.captured and send amountCents.

title: Make receipt-worker retries reliable
author: alex
head: receipt-retry
body: The receipt worker consumes payment.captured, creates a document from amount and currency, and retries failures.

title: Add a gradual-rollout flag for Checkout v2
author: sora
head: checkout-rollout
body: Fall back safely to v1 when CHECKOUT_V2_ENABLED is absent.

title: Cache admin authorization for order queries
author: yuna
head: admin-auth-cache
body: Cache admin authorization decisions for 30 seconds to reduce query API latency.
